_how: Copy to cot_inputs.json and fill from the CFTC Legacy report (Friday release, positions as of Tuesday) or the LTA SMI / Net Edge indicators. Oscillator = where this week's net position sits in its 26-week min-max range, 0-100. Book extremes: >=80 or <=20. Bias rule (pdf p97-p100): Commercials at one extreme AND Retail at the opposite = contrarian bias toward the Commercials' side.
